Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Returns 0 when the search string is empty.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: Returns 1 for empty-search cases because the generated XPath expression treats the empty string as contained at position 1.
Impact: Generated values differ from BizTalk.
Closure criteria: Match legacy empty-search behavior and add constant, linked, missing, empty, and repeated-input tests.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Uppercase and Lowercase handle non-ASCII characters.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: Uses ASCII-only XPath translate expressions.
Impact: Non-ASCII text is not converted consistently with BizTalk.
Closure criteria: Implement Unicode-compatible casing and verify supported execution engines with culture-sensitive cases.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Uses midpoint-to-even rounding and supports an optional precision input.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: Uses XPath round with one input.
Impact: Midpoint and precision results differ from BizTalk.
Closure criteria: Support both arities and BizTalk numeric behavior for positive and negative values, precision, and invalid inputs.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Namespace declarations on containing XSD constructs apply to descendant QName resolution.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: Element-local namespace handling is implemented, but some complex-type prefix overrides resolve the wrong imported type.
Impact: The mapper can load the wrong schema component and generate incorrect mappings.
Closure criteria: Propagate namespace scope through all relevant XSD constructs and compare resolution against a conforming XSD processor.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Persists standalone, DOCTYPE, CDATA elements, indentation, media type, and related output properties.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: Several output attributes are absent from the current model or serialization path.
Impact: Saving a BTM can silently lose configured output behavior.
Closure criteria: Model, serialize, expose, and honor every supported output property; verify repeated save and compilation behavior.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Validates input and output instances against their schemas.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: Transforms XML without equivalent source and target XSD validation.
Impact: A successful transform can produce schema-invalid output without being reported.
Closure criteria: Add dependency-aware input and output XSD validation with actionable diagnostics.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Provides bundled cross-reference functoids with IDs 5000 through 5006 and BizTalk runtime behavior.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: The seven cross-reference functoid IDs and runtime implementation are not registered.
Impact: Maps using cross-reference functoids cannot be edited or executed compatibly.
Closure criteria: Implement definitions, persistence, authoring, runtime dependencies, execution, and focused tests.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Allows extension objects to be used with generated mapping XSLT.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: Extension-object XML is rejected unless custom XSLT is also supplied.
Impact: Generated maps that call external extension objects cannot run.
Closure criteria: Support extension objects with generated XSLT, including binding, dependency resolution, diagnostics, and execution.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Provides a dedicated table-grid editor for rows, columns, gating, and extractor mappings.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: The model, serializer, and compiler support table metadata, but an equivalent grid editor is missing.
Impact: Existing maps may compile, but users cannot fully create or edit Table Looping configurations.
Closure criteria: Add a table-grid editor and verify gating, row order, extractor columns, save, reopen, and compilation.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Discovers Mapper Extensions assemblies and registers BaseFunctoid implementations.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: No equivalent custom functoid assembly discovery and registration workflow exists.
Impact: Legacy custom functoids are unavailable even when their assemblies are present.
Closure criteria: Add supported assembly discovery, metadata loading, palette registration, ID preservation, execution, and missing-dependency diagnostics.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Resolves and executes configured external assemblies within supported BizTalk environments.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: Assembly browsing and generated bindings exist, but clean-machine resolution, versioning, deployment, and runtime combinations are not fully verified.
Impact: A map can compile but fail when deployed or tested on another machine.
Closure criteria: Test real assemblies, supported signatures, versions, missing dependencies, clean installations, packaging, and execution engines.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Provides the BizTalk database functoid runtime implementation.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: Generated helpers depend on Microsoft.BizTalk.BaseFunctoids.FunctoidScripts.
Impact: Database maps are not portable to a standalone installation without BizTalk runtime dependencies.
Closure criteria: Provide a supported dependency strategy or compatible implementation and prove execution in the advertised runtime.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Migrates legacy srctree, sinktree, and functions map dialects to the current structure.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: The older dialect is explicitly rejected to avoid importing an empty or corrupted map.
Impact: Older BizTalk maps cannot be opened directly.
Closure criteria: Implement structural migration and compare functions, links, settings, identities, and execution against legacy results.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Generates instances that satisfy required schema constraints.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: Required repetitions are capped at five and generated instances are not fully schema validated.
Impact: Schemas with minOccurs greater than five and other constraints can produce invalid samples.
Closure criteria: Honor required counts or report a limit, support relevant facets and choices, and validate generated instances against the XSD.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Resolves supported project, assembly, import, include, and redefine dependencies.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: Local import and include work, but xs:redefine, imports without schemaLocation, and full project or assembly resolution are incomplete.
Impact: Some valid BizTalk schemas cannot be loaded deterministically.
Closure criteria: Implement the supported dependency mechanisms with deterministic resolution and explicit unsupported-case diagnostics.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Supports native-to-XML and XML-to-native testing with schema annotations and validation.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: Only XML transformation is available; no native conversion pipeline was found.
Impact: Flat-file maps cannot be tested end to end.
Closure criteria: Add native input and output conversion, annotations, validation, and diagnostics.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Persists and honors the complete legacy map-property and transformation-engine surface.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: Only part of the legacy property surface is represented; engine-selection intent is not equivalent.
Impact: Some saved settings and execution choices are ignored or lost.
Closure criteria: Inventory each property and either preserve and honor it or report it as unsupported.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Changes compiler behavior according to the selected optimization setting.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: The option is parsed and serialized but is not consumed by the compiler.
Impact: The saved option does not affect generated behavior.
Closure criteria: Implement equivalent optimization behavior or explicitly diagnose the unsupported setting and compare output.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Runs compiler and schema-aware validation across the complete map.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: Editor validation is basic and primarily active-page oriented.
Impact: Users can miss problems on other pages or in schema and compiler semantics.
Closure criteria: Route validation through full-map compiler and schema checks with page and element diagnostics.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Compile, Test, and Validate commands execute the complete requested workflow.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: Some commands redirect to editor actions or do not run the complete test workflow.
Impact: Command behavior differs from toolbar and legacy tooling behavior.
Closure criteria: Wire commands to the same complete operations with active-document handling, results, errors, and cancellation.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Provides user-facing transformation debugging with stepping and context inspection.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: No equivalent Debug Map workflow exists.
Impact: Users cannot debug mapping execution at the legacy tooling level.
Closure criteria: Define and implement stepping, source mapping, variables, context, and diagnostics for supported engines.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Supports relevance views, search, connected-subgraph operations, page operations, and granular undo units.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: Basic navigation, pages, clipboard, auto-linking, and some document-level undo work, but full workflow parity is not established.
Impact: Complex editing tasks are less efficient and may not undo at the same granularity.
Closure criteria: Define acceptance scenarios for search, relevance, connected copying, page reordering, granular undo and redo, and persistence.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Each bundled functoid has defined input coercion, culture, numeric, error, and boundary behavior.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: All 76 base IDs are registered, but only a subset has differential semantic evidence.
Impact: Palette coverage can be mistaken for execution compatibility.
Closure criteria: Build a differential matrix for every supported ID, arity, boundary, invalid input, warning, culture, and runtime.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Supports complex loops, schema constructs, multi-message maps, recursion, and deployment combinations.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: Implementations exist for several scenarios, but sufficient differential evidence is missing.
Impact: Unsupported or incorrect behavior may remain in complex customer maps.
Closure criteria: Compare representative fixtures against a working legacy baseline, including outputs, diagnostics, settings, and runtime dependencies.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Rejects a link when the target already has an output path back to the source and reports a circular linking structure.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: Link creation checks only exact duplicates; loaded maps and the compiler have no general dependency-cycle validation.
Impact: Cyclic maps such as NewMap66.btm can be created or loaded and may recurse or compile incorrectly.
Closure criteria: Run directed-graph reachability checks during link creation, loaded-map validation, assistant changes, and compilation; report the involved functoids.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Supports configurable warning levels and Treat Warnings as Errors.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: Warnings are produced, but no equivalent warning-level or warnings-as-errors policy is exposed.
Impact: Build and validation outcomes cannot match configured BizTalk warning policy.
Closure criteria: Add warning-level configuration, warning suppression rules, and warnings-as-errors behavior across editor, compiler, and commands.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Allows users to configure link labels, CopyName, CopyMixed, TopDown, and BottomUp directives.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: The serializer and compiler preserve or consume these values, but equivalent property editing is absent from the webview.
Impact: Existing values can survive, but users cannot fully author or change them.
Closure criteria: Add link-property UI, validation, undo and redo, round-trip tests, and generated-XSLT behavior tests.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Marks cyclic schema nodes, prevents endless expansion, and supports cyclic-node navigation and linking rules.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: The parser has recursion guards but no equivalent cyclic-node identity, icon, repeated-node UX, or comprehensive compatibility tests.
Impact: Recursive schemas may be truncated or presented differently from BizTalk.
Closure criteria: Model cyclic references explicitly and verify expansion, display, linking, paths, compilation, and serialization against legacy behavior.

Legacy BizTalk behavior or requirement: Integrates map compilation, warnings, generated artifacts, Test Map settings, and deployment with BizTalk projects.
Current Data Mapper V3 result: The VS Code extension packages and deploys maps through a narrower workflow rather than an equivalent BizTalk project build component.
Impact: Project build, artifact generation, settings propagation, and deployment outcomes differ.
Closure criteria: Define the supported project and deployment contract and add equivalent build integration or explicit migration tooling.
